name: Gladias
about: Costume test round 2: silhouettes that can't be read as present-day clothing.
descriptor: a man of about forty, slim and of medium height, light olive skin, short wavy chestnut-brown hair, a neatly trimmed short beard and hazel eyes, wearing a long sleeveless moss-green woven tabard with a sculpted standing collar that rises to his jaw, over a fitted cream long-sleeved bodysuit with seamless panels, a wide ochre cloth sash at the waist, slim tapered charcoal leggings, smooth seamless grey boots with thick soft soles, a thin silver band around his throat, a small earpiece and a slim pale ceramic wrist device
